title: Strategy row
description: One row of out/<portfolio>/strategies.csv and the <portfolio> strategies tab.

schema_version.description: report layout version; the app accepts major 1

status.description: as set in the portfolio file

break_even_rate.description: mean cost per contract (price + fee): the win rate needed to break even

edge_lo_cents.description: edge interval low (from the Wilson interval), cents

trades_to_detect.description: settled trades needed to detect trades_to_detect_edge_cents

trades_to_detect_edge_cents.description: edge size trades_to_detect refers to, cents

brier.description: Brier score of the model's probabilities

open_value_usd.description: open positions at liquidation value: proceeds of selling each at the recorded bids of its side now (best first), after the taker exit fee, summed over open trades with a fresh book; contracts the bids don't cover count at $0 (open_no_bid_contracts); open_unmarked are left out; 0 with no open positions, null when none is marked

unrealized_pnl_usd.description: open_value_usd minus those trades' entry cost (price x contracts + entry fee); same trades, same nulls

open_unmarked.description: open trades left out of open_value_usd: no snapshot within 15 minutes, market closed awaiting settlement, or no depth recorded for the trade's side (bids short of the position are marked, the rest at $0)

open_no_bid_contracts.description: contracts of marked open trades the recorded bids don't cover (sum of contracts - mark_contracts), valued at $0 in open_value_usd: a pending loss unless bids return; 0 with no open positions, null when none is marked

excluded_trades.description: trades excluded from statistics (nem trade exclude), settled and open: left out of trades, wins, win rate, edge, verdict, trades_to_detect, brier and the P&L statistics of this row (pnl_usd, roi, max_drawdown_usd), and of the portfolio's realized P&L, equity and open (treated as never taken); null only when an older 1.x file lacks the column

pending_locked_pnl_usd.description: sum of provisional_pnl_usd over counted (not excluded) open trades whose result is locked_win or locked_loss: the P&L they add if they settle as the observed running extreme already decides; reporting only (nem.settle.provisional): never in realized P&L, equity, statistics or risk; Kalshi's settlement decides; 0 with no open trades, null when not computed (nem summary --no-provisional, fetch failed for the whole run) or an older 1.x file

pending_likely_pnl_usd.description: same over likely_win / likely_loss (observed only at the exact extreme, or price at 98c+); conflicts are left out; reporting only (nem.settle.provisional): never in realized P&L, equity, statistics or risk; Kalshi's settlement decides; 0 with no open trades, null when not computed

pending_locked.description: counted open trades with a locked result (won or lost); 0 with no open trades, null when not computed

pending_likely.description: counted open trades with a likely result (won or lost); 0 with no open trades, null when not computed

pending_conflict.description: counted open trades where the observed and price bases disagree (not summed); 0 with no open trades, null when not computed
